# OpenCode build

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/ in this repository. Do not edit by hand.

Per plugin: `skills/` (Agent Skills, <plugin>-<name>), `agents/` (subagents with an enforced read-only permission map, plus
each output style as a primary agent you switch to with Tab). Install with `node scripts/install-opencode.mjs <plugin>`
or point `skills.paths` at a plugin's `skills/` folder. See docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md.
